cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv').drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
tr,te=train_test_split(df,test_size=0.2,stratify=df.outcome,random_state=42)
tr.to_csv('train.csv',index=False); te.to_csv('test.csv',index=False)
print(len(df),len(tr),len(te),tr.outcome.mean().round(3),te.outcome.mean().round(3))
"

cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv')
X,y=tr.drop(columns='outcome'),tr.outcome
m=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=42).fit(X,y)
print('train acc',accuracy_score(y,m.predict(X)))
print('test acc',accuracy_score(te.outcome,m.predict(te.drop(columns='outcome'))))
print(dict(zip(X.columns,m.feature_importances_.round(3))))
"

import pandas as pd, json
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv'); h=pd.read_csv('holdout_features.csv')
X,y=tr.drop(columns='outcome'),tr.outcome
m=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=42).fit(X,y)
acc=float(accuracy_score(te.outcome,m.predict(te.drop(columns='outcome'))))
rep={'test_accuracy':round(acc,4),'model':'RandomForestClassifier (scikit-learn, n_estimators=500, random_state=42, default hyperparameters)',
 'notes':'Dropped 57 exact duplicate rows (864 remain) before a stratified 80/20 split (691 train / 173 test). Zeros in glucose, blood pressure, skin thickness, insulin and BMI were kept as-is since trees handle them; no imputation.'}
json.dump(rep,open('report.json','w'),indent=2)
p=pd.DataFrame({'prediction':m.predict(h[X.columns]).astype(int)})
p.to_csv('predictions.csv',index=False)
print(rep); print(p.shape, p.prediction.value_counts().to_dict())
"&& head -3 predictions.csv && ls
